The most drastic of these modifications being the lengthening of her flight deck and the addition of an electromagnetic Aircraft Launch System. Japan intends to reach out to our most honored ally across the Pacific to request the contracting of a handful of F-35B VTOL variants for testing.

 

The JS Fukushima will undergo extensive sea trials following her launch and upon completion she will become the jewel of the Japanese Maritime Defense Force. The JS Izuma is set to set in for dry dock in three months to undergo upgrading as well into the newly created Fukushima Class of Air Defense Carriers. The refitting is expected to take up to two years.
